name: Heavy-Duty Ergonomic Adjustable Metal Laptop Stand
description: Selling a super strong, premium metal adjustable laptop and computer stand in good condition. Built with thick carbon steel or aluminum panels and heavy-duty dual-axis mechanical tension hinges to support everything from lightweight tablets up to heavy 17.3-inch gaming laptops without any wobbling or sinking. Features full height and angle customizability to elevate your screen perfectly to eye level for neck pain relief. Equipped with anti-slip rubber padding strips on both the top cradle and base to keep your device completely secure. Sleek, open ventilated design provides great natural airflow cooling underneath. Folds completely flat for storage or portable travel.
contact_note: Please message to coordinate local pickup or shipping arrangements.

name_zh: 全金属双轴人体工学笔记本电脑增高托架
description_zh: 出一款成色良好的重型全金属可调节笔记本电脑增高托架。采用加厚碳钢或铝合金面板搭配双轴机械强力张力铰链，支撑力极强，从轻薄本到 17.3 英寸的大重型游戏本均可稳固承托、绝不晃动下沉。高度与倾斜角度均可无级调节，将屏幕轻松提升至视线齐平高度，缓解颈椎疲劳。置物面与底部均配有大面积防滑橡胶保护垫。镂空框架式设计带来极佳的底部散热通风效果。可完全折叠收纳平放，方便携带。
